headline: Sensex and Nifty Erase Early Gains to Trade Lower; Reliance Jumps as Jio IPO Sees Record Demand

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Markets failed to sustain early morning gains of 1% driven by IT stocks and firm global cues
Vishal Mega Mart shares tumbled 6% following the announcement of its Q2 financial results
Selling pressure in the chemical and automobile sectors dragged down the Nifty and Sensex indices
Concerns over a potential Eurozone banking crisis and rising government borrowing costs weighed on sentiment
whatHappening: Jio's mega IPO of Rs 30,213 crore was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening on Day 1
Reliance Industries shares surged 3% in response to the overwhelming subscription demand for its telecom unit
State Bank of India is probing a potential data breach involving 3,900 customer records on the dark web
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories secured DCGI approval for the use of Zytorvi in treating esophageal cancer
summary: Indian indices turned volatile on October 21, erasing early gains of 500 points to trade in the red with Nifty falling below 22,800. Reliance Industries provided support, rising 3% as the Jio IPO achieved full subscription in record time. However, negative news regarding an SBI data probe and poor results from Vishal Mega Mart dampened investor confidence.
